The current code calls LogHybridPrediction immediately in OnInit(), which may attempt prediction before sufficient historical data is available. Don't log or predict until sufficient historical OHLC bars are available, and consider skipping the first prediction attempt on a fresh start to ensure adequate warm-up period. Skip the OnInit LogHybridPrediction call to avoid predicting with insufficient data. Also, verify that the number of available bars on the chart matches the expected count. For accuracy calculation, exclude draw predictions where g_prevPredictionDirection == 0 or actualDirection == 0 from scoring to only count up/down predictions. Only count up/down predictions in accuracy calculations, excluding draw predictions marked as direction 0. Increment score only when previous prediction direction is not zero, and only count correct predictions when the direction matches.</details></think>

The `HasEnoughHistory()` function checks if the available bars meet or exceed this requirement. In `LogHybridPrediction`, the function now exits early if insufficient data is present, and `OnInit` no longer calls `LogHybridPrediction` prematurely. Additionally, accuracy scoring excludes draws by only counting predictions where `g_prevPredictionDirection != 0`, and the display shows "n/a" for draws. - `Hybrid_LSTM_TA.mq5` biên dịch thành công.
- Đặt file ONNX đúng tên trong `MQL5/Files` (ví dụ `hybrid_lstm_xauusd_m1.onnx`); file train cũ `hybrid_lstm.onnx` cần đổi tên hoặc train lại theo quy ước tên.
